localization.name: Hario Switch 20:260
localization.short_description: Immersion-then-drain Switch recipe with pre-timer fill and dose

steps.description_source: Rinse the filter with hot water and close the switch so it's in immersion mode.
steps.description_template: Rinse the filter with hot water and close the switch so it's in immersion mode.

steps.description_source: Fill the brewer with 260 grams of water at around 94 degrees.
steps.description_template: Fill the brewer with 260 grams of water at around 94 degrees.

steps.description_source: Add your 20 grams of coffee straight into the water.
steps.description_template: Add your 20 grams of coffee straight into the water.

steps.description_source: We're gonna start the timer when we start our stir, so give it a good stir right as you hit start.
steps.description_template: We're gonna start the timer when we start our stir, so give it a good stir right as you hit start.

steps.description_source: At the 40 second mark, open the switch and let it start draining into the cup below.
steps.description_template: At the 40 second mark, open the switch and let it start draining into the cup below.

steps.description_source: Let it fully steep and drain until about 1:25, then pull the Switch off the cup and you're done.
steps.description_template: Let it fully steep and drain until about 1:25, then pull the Switch off the cup and you're done.
